name: 寶可夢卡牌家庭組合
englishName: Sword & Shield Family Pokémon Card Game

description.text: Family Pokémon Card Game, released on 6 August 2021: a set for families with three ready-built 60-card decks led by Cinderace V, Pikachu V and Tyranitar V, with a playmat, a coin, damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, deck bands, a damage-counter case and a storage box, two battle guides, a first-time guide and a battle sheet, and guidebooks for children and for parents.
